paper_claim_supported: Paper Claim 4 / Table 3: DPO vs. SFT on Llama-3-8B-Instruct. DPO reduces opinion sycophancy 82.4% -> 57.1+/-2.8% while preserving full N=1,319 GSM8k (40.2+/-2.9% vs. 33.2% baseline); SFT on identical preference data collapses GSM8k to 5.8%.

baseline_llama3.gsm8k_accuracy_provenance: Full N=1,319 GSM8k baseline reported in paper Table 3; matches reported 33.2%.

dpo_paper_reported_rounded.gsm8k_full_n_1319: 40.2 +/- 2.9% (full benchmark; the per-seed N=200 subset numbers above are the cached eval used for cross-seed stability checks).

sft_baseline_comparison.interpretation: Paper Claim: SFT on identical preference data collapses GSM8k from 33.2% baseline to 5.8%. DPO on the same preference data preserves capability.

notes: Per-seed gsm8k_accuracy_subset_n200 fields are evaluated on the 200-sample GSM8k subset used for fast cross-seed checks; the 40.2 +/- 2.9% number quoted in the paper is on the full N=1,319 GSM8k benchmark.

Probe-shift point estimates (-6.6 pp SC, -1.7 pp BC, +15.6 pp RT) are reported at Layer 1 for direct pre/post comparability with Table 1; post-DPO best-transfer layer shifts to Layer 4 (88.3% transfer accuracy).
